implemented.existingInterface: BoundedDynamicPlasmaStrategy extends PlasmaStrategy; async quote(context) and apply(context, quote)
implemented.selection: An enumerable own DATA requiredFusedPolicyVersion: 1 opts into the existing four-field shared-policy adapter. Absence retains the three-field contract.
behavior: Validate exact unsigned-context shape, declared phase and digests before selecting either path.
Delegate tagged quote/apply to the published required-fused policy adapter without reimplementing its arithmetic, receipt checks or current-frontier/resource bounds.
Preserve four-field requiredFusedPlasma as the fused-only TOTAL in the adapter receipt, distinct from original selected headroom and hybrid fusion/PoW fields.
Return only the original frozen fusedPlasma/difficulty pair; never a block, signature or replacement payment.
Reject malformed version tags, untagged four-field observations, wrong phase/arity, cross-version receipts and unsupported four-field observations without automatic downgrade.
Use null-prototype private context snapshots; reject proxies/getters/extra fields before invoking input hooks.
implemented.plannerLimitation: The central transaction-planner source remains an abstract interface. This implements the existing strategy SPI, not a complete preparer or authenticated runtime selection.
implemented.trustLimitation: UNSIGNED, subject/runtime digests and chain-profile match are declared DATA. Self-consistent receipts are not authenticated issuance, ownership, signer-state or current-authority proof.
